      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp (+36/-19) to handle I/O failures and corruption explicitly.",
      "band": "P2",

      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "TxIndex previously returned empty results on disk read failures and database corruption, silently returning false negatives for confirmed transactions. Throwing runtime errors preserves index data integrity and alerts callers rather than quietly misreporting missing data."
    },

      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp to surface proper errors for getrawtransaction and REST endpoints.",

      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Getrawtransaction and REST endpoints now distinguish I/O errors and pruned or downloading blocks from actually nonexistent transactions. This fixes misleading error codes returned to RPC clients without disrupting standard lookup paths."
